description: issue #679 (SP7): the reserved-word rule covers struct CONSTRUCTORS as well as procedures, so with `sprites` active `struct tell`/`struct ask`/`struct each` each raise `ol-reserved-word` at the struct-name token. `struct` is one of the grammar's four declaration slots (spec/grammar.md:382), which is why this fixture is unaffected by maintainer ruling #833. Scope note, twice corrected: when this fixture was written the `variables` third of spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154's sentence was not diagnosed (`:tell = 1` checked clean); Epic-Gate finding B3 took that up as issue #739, which made it raise; ruling #833 then reversed #739 and made binding free again, permanently — spec/grammar.md:386 now makes accepting any name in a binding position a normative MUST, and spec/grammar.md:408 says what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS, never whether a program may declare it. The sibling fixture reserved-bindings-with-sprites pins that reversal; the profile document's older wording was realigned by issue #855. This fixture owns the struct-constructor case, which is a declaration and still collides.

diagnostics.message: tell is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
ask is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
each is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
